test_create_with_missing_whitelisted_key.contract: DB-CRUD-004: missing whitelisted keys are inserted as NULL/column default. data/schema.md (DATA-014): accounts.kind defaults to 'checking'.
test_create_with_missing_whitelisted_key.happened: db.create(c, 'accounts', {'name': 'only name'}) raised sqlite3.IntegrityError: NOT NULL constraint failed: accounts.kind. The missing key was inserted as NULL, so the column default was not used.
test_create_with_missing_whitelisted_key.note: Also CONTRACT UNCLEAR (F-15): 'NULL/column default' is ambiguous for NOT NULL columns. The API always sends kind, so this is only reachable through the data layer.

test_opening_balance_is_the_start_checkp.contract: E2E-ONBOARD-005: the account's starting month opens at the start balance.
test_opening_balance_is_the_start_checkp.happened: forecast.compute: for start month 2026-01 with a start checkpoint on 2026-01-15 (balance 100000) the account's per-month 'opening' is None, not 100000.
test_opening_balance_is_the_start_checkp.note: FC-006 does not define 'opening' for the start month (F-19), so the wording of the clause is thin. The e2e clause is explicit. Same finding at HTTP level in test_forecast_of_the_new_account_opens_at_the_start_balance.

test_forecast_of_the_new_account_opens_a.contract: E2E-ONBOARD-005: GET /api/forecast?start=2026-01&months=12 -> 12 months; the starting month opens at the start balance.
test_forecast_of_the_new_account_opens_a.happened: The 12 months are returned, but the account's opening in 2026-01 is null instead of 100000 (assert None == 100000).
test_forecast_of_the_new_account_opens_a.note: Same root cause as test_opening_balance_is_the_start_checkpoint. Possibly intended (the account did not exist at the start of the month) but then the e2e clause is wrong.

test_run_response_has_the_same_fields_as.contract: API-BKP-001 / API-BKP shape: POST /api/backup/run returns 200 BackupStatusOut with every field (nullable fields present as null).
test_run_response_has_the_same_fields_as.happened: After a first-ever failed run the POST response lacks keys that GET /api/backup/status returns (e.g. last_success); the key sets differ.
test_run_response_has_the_same_fields_as.note: GET status does include all keys. Clients reading last_success from the POST response get a KeyError/undefined.

test_status_after_error_sets_last_error.contract: BKP-018 / API-BKP shape: after an error last_error is set and last_success/last_version are unchanged (null when there was no success).
test_status_after_error_sets_last_error.happened: KeyError: 'last_success' on the POST /api/backup/run response after a failed first run: the key is absent rather than null.
